decision: Group-aware 80:20 multilabel stratification
justification: 127628 training and 31911 validation comments. Maximum label prevalence difference is 0.0116 percentage points. All 21 partition integrity checks passed.

decision: Retain all 63978 fully labelled official test comments
justification: 89186 unlabelled records excluded. Official benchmark preserved for frozen final evaluation. Historical benchmark exposure acknowledged.

decision: Representative subset of 59997 training comments
justification: Reduces training sample count by 52.99%. Maximum label prevalence difference is 0.0047 percentage points. Retains 179 threat-positive examples. Full-data experiments will investigate the effect of data size.

decision: Compare standard BCE, weighted BCE and focal loss
justification: Investigate imbalance-aware learning without naive resampling.

decision: Validation Macro Average Precision
justification: Evaluate ranking performance across equally weighted labels under class imbalance.

decision: Validation-based per-label F1 optimization
justification: Account for different label frequencies and decision boundaries.

decision: 256 tokens for initial transformer experiments
justification: Representative subset truncation rates are 6.86% for DistilBERT and 6.92% for RoBERTa. Content token retention is 82.38% and 81.86%, respectively. Longer sequence experiments will investigate rare-label performance.

decision: Fixed initial random seed of 42
justification: Maintain consistent experimental conditions across model comparisons.

decision: Remove 32 overlapping training records
justification: Eliminates detected normalized-text overlap with the official labelled test dataset while preserving the benchmark.

decision: Preserve complete normalized duplicate groups
justification: 233 duplicate groups remain in the development pool, including 41 groups with conflicting annotations. Original annotations are preserved without arbitrary relabelling.

decision: Toxicity-enriched subset of 59997 comments
justification: Retains all 12969 toxic training comments and all rare-label positives. Equal sample size enables a controlled comparison with representative sampling.

decision: Preserve original comment text
justification: EDA identified differences in capitalization and punctuation between clean and toxic comments. Normalized text is used only for duplicate detection and grouping.

decision: Dynamic batch-level padding
justification: Median token length is approximately 52-53 tokens. Dynamic padding avoids unnecessary padding of short comments to the maximum sequence length.

decision: Compare 256 tokens against 384 or 512 tokens
justification: Severe toxic and threat comments exhibit substantial aggregate token loss at 256 tokens. Additional context may improve classification, subject to validation evidence and GPU resources.

decision: Word TF-IDF with unigrams and bigrams
justification: Captures individual words and local linguistic context. Stopwords and single-character words are retained. Stemming and lemmatization are avoided to preserve word forms.

decision: Minimum document frequency of 2
justification: Approximately 74 percent of unique word features appear in only one training document. Filtering retains 88.39 percent of word n-gram occurrences before applying the feature budget.

decision: Character TF-IDF with 2-5 grams
justification: Captures short and longer character patterns, misspellings and punctuation. Retains 91.78 percent of character n-gram occurrences at the selected feature budget. All 22 word zero-feature comments receive nonzero character representations.

decision: Common feature budget of 50000
justification: Word TF-IDF retains 77.13 percent of original word n-gram occurrences at min_df=2. Equal dimensionality supports controlled representation comparisons while limiting computational requirements.

decision: 25000 word and 25000 character features
justification: Equal initial allocation maintains the same total dimensionality as individual representations. Component-wise and final L2 normalization control the scale of document vectors.

decision: Sublinear TF, smooth IDF and L2 normalization
justification: Reduces the influence of highly repetitive terms and controls differences in document vector magnitude. Identical weighting settings support controlled comparisons.

decision: Float32 CSR matrices and reusable fitted vectorizers
justification: Sparse storage avoids unnecessary dense memory allocation. Six matrices, four vectorizers and two row manifests passed verification. Sampled feature reconstruction produced zero numerical error.

decision: Fit vectorizers exclusively on training comments
justification: Validation comments are transformed using the vocabulary and IDF weights learned exclusively from training data. The official test dataset has not been loaded.

decision: Multinomial Naive Bayes with alpha=1.0 and empirical class priors
justification: Standard reproducible probabilistic baseline using nonnegative word TF-IDF features and natural training prevalence. Establishes a reference before stronger classical and transformer experiments.

decision: One-vs-Rest for classical classifiers
justification: Supports six independently predicted binary labels without imposing mutual exclusivity between toxicity categories.

decision: Shared evaluation and exact per-label threshold optimization
justification: Consistent metric definitions across classifiers. Threshold optimization examines available validation score cutoffs and selects the highest threshold among tied maximum F1 values.

decision: Retain standard Naive Bayes baseline
justification: Validation Macro AP is 0.419750. Threshold optimization improves Macro F1 from 0.230400 to 0.436343. Further Naive Bayes tuning is deprioritized to focus on stronger classifiers and required transformer experiments.

decision: L2-regularized Logistic Regression with liblinear solver and C=1.0
justification: Provides a consistent sparse binary classification baseline. All four experiments converged without warnings. Hyperparameters were held constant during controlled comparisons.

decision: Compare word, character and combined TF-IDF using a fixed 50000-feature budget
justification: Controls total feature dimensionality, training samples and classifier configuration while investigating representation effectiveness.

decision: Select combined_tfidf for the controlled weighting experiment
justification: Combined TF-IDF achieves validation Macro AP of 0.647109, compared with 0.640656 for character and 0.617407 for word. The improvement is descriptive and statistical significance has not been established.

decision: Compare balanced class weighting against unweighted Logistic Regression
justification: Weighting improves Macro AP from 0.647109 to 0.671787. Rare-label detection improves overall without changing training sample composition. Micro AP and severe toxicity performance decline, demonstrating label-specific trade-offs.

decision: Select LR_COMBINED_BALANCED_S42
justification: Highest validation Macro AP of 0.671787 and optimized Macro F1 of 0.659754 among the four evaluated LR configurations. Selection is restricted to Logistic Regression and does not freeze the final project model.

decision: Retain four controlled Logistic Regression runs without additional regularization tuning
justification: Representation, weighting and threshold effects have been investigated using a fixed configuration. Additional hyperparameter searches are deprioritized to complete the remaining classical models and required transformer experiments.

decision: Use LinearSVC with L2 regularization, squared hinge loss, primal optimization and C=1.0
justification: Suitable baseline for high-dimensional sparse text classification. All 24 binary classifiers converged without warnings. The configuration was held constant across controlled comparisons.

decision: Evaluate signed decision margins using a default threshold of zero and per-label validation thresholds
justification: LinearSVC produces signed margins rather than probabilities. Negative thresholds are supported by the verified shared evaluation module. Pooled micro ranking metrics require caution because independent classifiers may have different score scales.

decision: Select combined_tfidf for the balanced class weighting experiment
justification: Combined TF-IDF achieves Macro AP of 0.662505, compared with 0.657362 for character and 0.632156 for word. The comparison uses a fixed total feature budget. Statistical significance has not been established.

decision: Retain balanced weighting as a controlled extension and retain its negative result
justification: Balanced weighting changes Macro AP from 0.662505 to 0.659581 and optimized Macro F1 from 0.656899 to 0.650759. Although default Macro F1 and severe toxicity performance improve, overall selection metrics decline after threshold optimization. This contrasts with Logistic Regression.

decision: Select SVM_COMBINED_BASELINE_S42
justification: Highest validation Macro AP of 0.662505 among the four evaluated SVM configurations. Selection is restricted to Linear SVM and does not freeze the final project model.

decision: Retain four controlled Linear SVM experiments without additional regularization or weight searches
justification: Representation, class weighting and threshold effects have been evaluated. Additional tuning is deprioritized to preserve resources for remaining classical models and required transformer experiments. Conclusions remain conditional on the evaluated configurations.

decision: Use a complexity-controlled unweighted DecisionTreeClassifier with word TF-IDF
justification: Maintain the common feature comparison while restricting depth to 30, leaves to 512 and minimum leaf size to 5. These are predefined baseline restrictions, not optimized parameters.

decision: Verify tree structure and class alignment instead of iterative convergence
justification: All six trees satisfy predefined structural restrictions. Every tree reaches the depth limit, but none reaches the leaf limit. Model and metric reconstruction passed.

decision: Retain training-validation gaps and probability concentration as model limitation evidence
justification: Training Macro AP is 0.729854, while validation Macro AP is 0.421514. The resulting gap is 0.308340. Severe toxicity has the largest AP gap, and threat has the highest probability concentration.

decision: Retain one predefined Decision Tree baseline without additional hyperparameter searches
justification: The evaluated configuration ranks 3 of 4 common-feature baselines by validation Macro AP. Further tuning is deprioritized to preserve resources for Random Forest and the required transformer, fairness and explainability stages. Results do not establish the best achievable Decision Tree performance.

decision: Use 50 trees per label with full-size bootstrap sampling and sqrt feature selection
justification: Retain the common word TF-IDF representation and Decision Tree structural restrictions. Limit ensemble size to preserve computational resources for mandatory transformer experiments.

decision: Verify every individual tree and its actual bootstrap class support
justification: All 300 trees satisfy the predefined limits and contain both classes. Observed bootstrap support is consistent with theoretical expectations. Corresponding trees across labels use shared bootstrap draws due to the common random seed.

decision: Use sequential tree probability averaging during validation and subsequent inference
justification: Retain parallel training while avoiding changes in floating-point accumulation order at threshold boundaries. Reloaded validation scores were reconstructed with zero error.

decision: Retain the ensemble comparison and label-specific limitations as research evidence
justification: Macro AP improves by 0.165271 over Decision Tree. The overall AP generalization gap decreases by 39.3631%. Threat remains an exception with a larger AP gap and lower optimized F1.

decision: Retain one predefined Random Forest baseline without additional hyperparameter tuning
justification: The configuration ranks 3 of 5 common-feature baselines. Validation Macro F1 improves from 0.051017 to 0.586044 after tuning. Further forest optimization is deprioritized in favor of mandatory project deliverables.

decision: Normalize historical threshold configuration formats in memory without modifying source artifacts
justification: Five experiments use thresholds and six use optimized_thresholds. All eleven experiments reproduce their saved predictions, thresholds and registered metrics with zero differences.

decision: Distinguish matched word-feature algorithm comparisons from overall configuration comparisons
justification: Linear SVM leads the five common word-feature baselines, while balanced combined Logistic Regression leads the eleven evaluated configurations.

decision: Retain positive and negative representation, weighting and threshold optimization findings
justification: Combined features improve both linear classifiers. Balanced weighting improves Logistic Regression but reduces Linear SVM Macro AP slightly. Per-label threshold optimization improves validation Macro F1 for all eleven configurations.

decision: Select LR_COMBINED_BALANCED_S42 as the primary classical reference and full-data scaling candidate
justification: Highest validation Macro AP of 0.671787 among eleven completed configurations. Selection follows the predefined validation-only policy.

decision: Retain SVM_COMBINED_BASELINE_S42 as a secondary classical reference
justification: Validation Macro AP of 0.662505 and the highest optimized Micro F1 among the evaluated classical configurations. Retain complementary precision, recall and runtime trade-offs.

decision: Complete representative-subset classical experiments and proceed to transformer fine-tuning
justification: All eleven planned configurations have been trained, evaluated, registered and consolidated. Additional classical hyperparameter searches are deprioritized. Full-data scaling remains pending.

decision: Use pinned uncased tokenizer, maximum length 256 and dynamic padding to multiples of eight.
justification: Preserves the predefined sequence-length policy while reducing unnecessary padding.

decision: Compare standard BCE, square-root weighted BCE and focal loss with gamma 2 and alpha factor 1.
justification: Investigates imbalance handling independently under matched experimental conditions.

decision: Retain FP16, effective batch size 32, AdamW learning rate 2e-5 and three maximum epochs.
justification: Full-model smoke tests verified the predefined configuration and incomplete accumulation groups.

decision: Use identical initial weights and deterministic sample ordering across all three loss experiments.
justification: Controlled signatures and checkpoint recovery tests support reproducible comparisons.

decision: Select T03_FOCAL_S42 as the leading DistilBERT candidate using validation Macro AP.
justification: Highest validation Macro AP under the predefined selection criterion. Statistical superiority over the runner-up has not been established.

decision: Retain T02_WBCE_S42 as the strongest optimized Macro F1 candidate.
justification: Weighted BCE achieved higher optimized Macro F1 and stronger threat detection than focal loss.

decision: Preserve selected models and essential evidence; remove verified redundant model and optimizer checkpoints after completed training.
justification: Reduces Drive storage. Previous T01 restart and optimizer checkpoint mismatch are documented. Exact optimizer continuation of completed runs is no longer available.

decision: Use the pinned RoBERTa tokenizer with 256-token truncation and dynamic padding.
justification: Preserves the original development partitions and matched sequence-length budget.

decision: Compare standard BCE, square-root weighted BCE and focal loss with gamma 2.
justification: Matches DistilBERT loss configurations and isolates loss-function effects within RoBERTa.

decision: Retain the matched transformer training budget and identical within-family initialization.
justification: All three runs completed 5625 successful updates without AMP-skipped updates.

decision: Require exact saved-state restoration and numerically verified continuation.
justification: Initial bitwise continuation comparison failed. A shared-prefix follow-up passed all documented numerical tolerances. Both results are preserved. Bitwise training reproducibility is not established.

decision: Use local recovery checkpoints every 500 updates and persistent Drive checkpoints at epoch boundaries.
justification: Reduces persistent storage and checkpoint-writing overhead. Local checkpoints can be lost on runtime reset. Superseded models and completed optimizer states were removed after verification.

decision: Retain the recovered T05 Weighted BCE experiment.
justification: The observed notebook execution log reports recovery from local checkpoint update 4000, Epoch 3, row 8000. The run completed all scheduled updates and passed selected-model reload and artifact verification.

decision: Select T06_FOCAL_S42 as the leading representative-subset RoBERTa candidate.
justification: Highest validation Macro AP across the 17 completed configurations. Selection uses validation only. Statistical superiority is not established.

decision: Retain T05_WBCE_S42 and T03_FOCAL_S42 as relevant alternative candidates.
justification: RoBERTa weighted BCE achieves the highest optimized Macro F1. DistilBERT focal offers a useful performance-efficiency trade-off.

decision: Completed S01 and S02; retain validation-selected best epochs and thresholds.
justification: Both high-priority full-data runs completed; scaling changes both data volume and optimizer updates.

decision: Record unconfirmed historical S02 determinism policy.
justification: S02 explicit deterministic execution was verified by its smoke test; exact historical policy was unavailable.

decision: Retain original six validation-optimized S02 thresholds.
justification: 200 group bootstrap replicates per label; threat threshold widest. No bootstrap-based threshold change.

decision: Defer S03, R01, A01, A02 and A03.
justification: GPU quota, elapsed training time and deadline; mandatory test, fairness, explanation and delivery take priority.

decision: Select S02 by validation Macro AP and freeze all 19 completed runs.
justification: Validation-only ranking reconstructed from saved predictions; test results not used for selection.

decision: No post-freeze tuning or model replacement based on official test.
justification: Later extensions must be separate exploratory runs; historical team test exposure disclosed.
